turns.question: Our project concerns handling late sensor readings in an event-time windowed service. For the planned deployment, set application.id to birch-windows-17. Which value should we use, and which ordering of processing and offset saving gives at-least-once consumption?

turns.answer: The project application.id is birch-windows-17. Read, process, then save the position gives at-least-once consumption.
key_facts: The project application.id is birch-windows-17.
